'''Nightlily''' is a horse owned by [[Nemaris]] and used by [[Siuan Sanche]].

==Appearance==
Nightlily is a meek, dark mare.

==Activities==
Siuan Sanche borrows Nightlily from Nemaris' husband to ride from [[Gareth Bryne]]'s camp to the [[Aes Sedai]] camp.
